indicators.value: unincorporated organized territory of the US with local self-government; republican form of territorial government with separate executive, legislative, and judicial branches; note - reference Puerto Rican Federal Relations Act, 2 March 1917, as amended by Public Law 600, 3 July 1950
civil law system based on the Spanish civil code and within the framework of the US federal system
previous 1900 (Organic Act, or Foraker Act); latest ratified by referendum 3 March 1952, approved 3 July 1952, effective 25 July 1952
18 years of age; universal; note - island residents are US citizens but do not vote in US presidential elections
